Who is also a **well-known serial rapist** exploiting her community standing and personal control over her “trans shelters” to rape, threaten, harass, and exact sexual favours from younger transfems who sought shelter there due to domestic violence or homelessness.

Many of Han Lianyi／寒涟漪's victims have stood forward to expose what she did to them, only to be piled on, cyberbullied, and dismissed as “spreading rumours” by Han herself and her friends, often putting out her own dossiers on how the survivor is mentally unstable and hence untrustworthy. **At least one trans woman (浅羽悠月) have commited suicide** after going public with Han's rape of her, while multiple other survivors deleted their Twitter accounts in the backlash of their own disclosures.

To this date, Han Lianyi has never taken any accountability in those cases, nor has she ever acknowledged that she had caused any harm, or done anything wrong, against any of the survivors. She would often promise to do better—but never, never once, does she admit to have harmed people and taken accountability for it. It is always “rumours” or “misunderstanding”.

People in the community are often scared of coming out in support of survivors, partially due to Han Lianyi's community standing leading them to doubt the survivors' accounts, and partially out of fear that trans shelters would stop operation if Han were to take accountability and withdraw her involvement. However, continuation of the status quo meant that Han Lianyi is free to continue with her targeted sexual abuse and exploitation of marginalised transfems, and imitators abound when they see that even well-known abusers manage to stay out of trouble and even seem to maintain the respect of the community at large.

This is not hypothetical. Quite a few people who were involved in trans shelter operations have followed Han's “example”, and even outside of that specific setting, people would often cite Han to defend their own problematic behaviour when challenged. The degree of sexual violence being tolerated in Chinese transfem communities today is simply unacceptable. There is no consensus on believing the survivor, indeed quite the opposite, a tendency to dismiss survivor accounts takes hold whenever someone would claim to have materially helped the survivor, from which a familiar discourse of the survivor being “ungrateful” readily emerge.

I cannot agree with promoting Han Lianyi／寒涟漪 in this manner as a figure to be trusted, when we all know what I have stated above. I do not care what she said in this instance. Han Lianyi continues to exert control and command influence from the trans shelters under her franchise across China, and as long as that continues then Han is an active threat to the community, even were we to disregard the deaths and trauma that she had inflicted and refused to take accountability for (and certainly, we should not disregard them).

There was already one instance of academic researchers who insisted on a collaboration with Han Lianyi despite knowing her (continued) abuses, because they believed this was “necessary evil” for writing about Chinese transfems. That was a deeply harmful and unethical decision, and we should not repeat it—we should know better. It would be an even greater disservice to the community if we don't.
